text_en: What is the maximum speed limit in urban areas (cities and towns) in Rwanda?
text_rw: Umuvuduko ntarengwa mu mijyi yo mu Rwanda ni uwuhe?
text_fr: Quelle est la vitesse maximale en agglomération au Rwanda?
explanation_en: According to Article 42 of Rwanda Traffic Law, urban areas have a general speed limit of 50 km/h.

text_en: When approaching a roundabout, who has the right of way?
text_rw: Mbere yo kwinjira ku mzunguko, ni nde ufite uburenganzira bwo gutambuka?
text_fr: À l'approche d'un rond-point, qui a la priorité?
options_en: Vehicles already circulating inside the roundabout
explanation_en: Traffic already circulating inside the roundabout always has priority unless traffic police or signals direct otherwise.

text_en: On which side should you overtake another vehicle in Rwanda?
text_rw: Gucira ikindi kinyabiziga bikorerwa ku ruhe ruhande?
text_fr: De quel côté devez-vous dépasser un autre véhicule?
explanation_en: Overtaking must strictly be executed on the left side of the vehicle being passed.

text_en: What is the legal blood alcohol limit for drivers in Rwanda?
text_rw: Ikigero cy'alukole cyemewe ku batwara ibinyabiziga mu Rwanda ni iki?
text_fr: Quel est le taux d'alcoolémie légal pour les conducteurs?
explanation_en: Rwanda maintains a strict zero tolerance policy (0.00g/l) for alcohol in drivers.

text_en: Are front and rear seatbelts mandatory for all vehicle occupants?
text_rw: Ese kwambara umukand-umutekano ni ngombwa ku bari mu modoka bose?
text_fr: La ceinture de sécurité est-elle obligatoire pour tous les occupants?
explanation_en: All occupants in both front and rear seats must wear seatbelts while the vehicle is in motion.

text_en: What does a triangular traffic sign with a red border indicate?
text_rw: Ikimenyetso cy'umuhanda gifite ifasi y'mpande eshatu n'umutuku kivuga iki?
text_fr: Que signifie un panneau de signalisation triangulaire à bord rouge?
explanation_en: Triangular signs with a red border warn drivers of upcoming road dangers or hazards.

text_en: Can you park your vehicle on a pedestrian crossing or within 5 meters of it?
text_rw: Ese ushobora guhagarara ku cyambukiriro cy'abanyamaguru cyangwa hafi yacyo?
text_fr: Pouvez-vous stationner sur un passage pour piétons?
options_en: Yes, if hazard lights are on
explanation_en: Parking or stopping on or immediately near pedestrian crossings obstructs visibility and is strictly prohibited.

text_en: What is the speed limit on rural roads in Rwanda unless posted otherwise?
text_rw: Umuvuduko ku mihanda yo mu cyaro mu Rwanda ni uwuhe?
text_fr: Quelle est la vitesse sur les routes rurales au Rwanda?
explanation_en: Rural roads have a standard speed limit of 80 km/h.

text_en: What should a driver do when approaching a yellow traffic light?
text_rw: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agomba gukora iki abonye amatara y'umuhondo?
text_fr: Que doit faire un conducteur à l'approche d'un feu jaune?
options_en: Stop if it can be done safely
explanation_en: A yellow light means stop unless you are too close to stop safely before the intersection.

text_en: Who must wear a certified helmet while riding a motorcycle?
text_rw: Ni nde ugomba kwambara ingofero (helmet) yemejwe igihe atwaye ipikipiki?
text_fr: Qui doit porter un casque homologué à moto?
explanation_en: Both the motorcycle operator and passenger must wear certified safety helmets at all times.

text_en: What documents must a driver always carry while operating a motor vehicle in Rwanda?
text_rw: Ni ayahe nyandiko umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agomba kugira igihe cyose?
text_fr: Quels documents un conducteur doit-il toujours avoir sur lui?
options_en: Driving license, vehicle registration, and insurance
explanation_en: Drivers must carry their valid driving license, vehicle registration card, and proof of valid motor insurance.

text_en: What does a solid continuous white line in the middle of the road mean?
text_rw: Umurongo wera udacagase mu hagati y'umuhanda usobanura iki?
text_fr: Que signifie une ligne blanche continue au milieu de la route?
options_en: Crossing or overtaking is strictly prohibited
explanation_en: A solid white line indicates that crossing or overtaking is strictly forbidden.
